steps.input:
{
 "path": "programs/task-b5723233.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The patterned rectangle is the non-background, non-zero object above the blank target.
    bg = grid[0][0]
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
             if grid[r][c] not in (bg, 0)]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
    target = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 0]
    tr0 = min(r for r, c in target)
    tr1 = max(r for r, c in target)
    tc0 = min(c for r, c in target)
    tc1 = max(c for r, c in target)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for dr in range(tr1 - tr0 + 1):
        for dc in range(tc1 - tc0 + 1):
            out[tr0 + dr][tc0 + dc] = grid[r0 + dr][c1 - dc]
    return out
"
}
